bukhari:4449.note: Aisha: the Prophet died in her house, leaning against her chest (read against the hadith-api English edition)

bukhari:24.note: Haya (modesty) is a part of faith (read against hadith-api and sunnah.com)

bukhari:3197.note: Abu Bakra: twelve months, four sacred (Dhul-Qa'dah, Dhul-Hijjah, Muharram, Rajab) (read against hadith-api)

bukhari:1969.note: Aisha: he fasted most in Sha'ban of any month apart from Ramadan (read against hadith-api)

bukhari:6035.note: Masruq from Abdullah ibn Amr: the best among you are the best in character (checked against sunnah.com)

bukhari:1981.note: Abu Huraira: the Prophet advised three things: fast three days a month, two rak'ahs of Duha, witr before sleeping (read against hadith-api)

bukhari:5186.note: Abu Huraira: take care of the women, treat them well (read against hadith-api)

bukhari:6192.note: Abu Huraira: the Prophet changed Barrah's name to Zaynab (read against hadith-api)

bukhari:5640.note: Aisha: no calamity befalls a Muslim but Allah expiates some sins by it (read against hadith-api)
